svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 285 mm of 70 x 6 mm steel flat bar; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three holes on the centre line, measured from the top end:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolt 11 mm at 25; axle 20.5 mm at 105; lock stud 11 mm at 245.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drop pin slot: 8.5 mm wide on a 163 mm radius from the axle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole, centred 268 from the top, 7.5 degrees long (21 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between the end centres): drill both ends, saw and file between.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the axle hole in steps (6, 12, 18, 20.5 mm) on a drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint or galvanise; leave the face around the axle bare and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: greased, and the face around the stud bare for the lock.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flat on the inner face of the upright, holes on the upright

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes; the M10 plate bolt at the top, the stud at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 20 mm bar passes through plate and upright together.
